interface.longDescription: Bioinformatics adds omics skills, NCBI, bioRxiv/medRxiv, RNAcentral, EFO, UniProt, AlphaFold, STRING, RCSB PDB, Reactome, Ensembl, ClinVar, gnomAD, GWAS Catalog, Open Targets, ChEMBL, PubChem, ChEBI, QuickGO, PRIDE, BioStudies/ArrayExpress, CELLxGENE, Human Protein Atlas, MetaboLights, HMDB, MGnify, ENCODE, cBioPortal, KEGG MCP retrieval tools, and local omics visualization routing tools, plus a stable app-renderable record contract.
capabilities: NCBI PubMed, PMC, Gene, Taxonomy, GEO, BioProject, BioSample, SRA, Entrez link, dynamic database/identifier context resolution, and app preview hint MCP tools
bioRxiv and medRxiv preprint metadata and publication-linkage MCP tools with DOI links, preprint pages, JATS XML links, abstracts, citation previews, and browser/API provenance
RNAcentral RNA entry lookup, text search, and cross-reference MCP tools with RNA sequences, species/TaxID metadata, source database groups, xref tables, and browser/API links
EFO ontology term lookup, search, children, and descendants MCP tools with definitions, synonyms, obsolete/replacement metadata, xref groups, relation networks, and OLS4 browser/API links
UniProtKB search, accession lookup, dynamic accession/organism/feature/xref context resolution, FASTA retrieval, feature summaries, cross-reference groups, app preview hints, and status MCP tools
AlphaFold DB UniProt accession lookup with predicted structure files, confidence metadata, and 3D preview hints
STRING identifier mapping, dynamic identifier/species/network context resolution, and protein interaction network MCP tools with app-renderable nodes, edges, scores, and links
RCSB PDB structure lookup, search, dynamic search-hit/PDB/download context resolution, FASTA retrieval, polymer/ligand summaries, structure-file URLs, and 3D preview hints

Reactome pathway lookup, search, identifier-to-pathway mapping, and dynamic pathway/species/resource context resolution with participant network/table previews, citation lists, recommended calls, and browser/API links

Ensembl stable ID lookup, xref retrieval, region overlap, variation lookup, and dynamic stable-ID/region/variant/species/feature context resolution with gene, genomic feature, variant, table, and xref previews

ClinVar variation lookup, search, and dynamic VCV/variant/clinical-significance context resolution with clinical significance, review status, gene/dbSNP links, locations, submissions, recommended calls, and variant previews

gnomAD variant frequency, gene constraint, and dynamic variant/gene/dataset/reference-genome context resolution with population, transcript, constraint, table, xref, browser-link, and recommended-call previews

GWAS Catalog variant, mapped-gene, trait association evidence lookup, and dynamic rsID/gene/trait context resolution with study tables, PubMed evidence, EFO traits, GWAS links, and recommended follow-up calls

Open Targets target, disease, search, and dynamic target/disease context resolution with target-disease association scores, datasource/datatype evidence tables, ontology xrefs, browser links, and recommended follow-up calls

ChEMBL compound, target, assay, document, activity, mechanism, drug-indication REST lookup, and dynamic molecule/target/assay/document/activity context resolution with chemical structure previews, molecule properties, target components, assay metadata, source-document citations, activity tables, mechanism references, disease term identifiers, indication evidence links, recommended calls, and browser/API links

PubChem compound, BioAssay, Substance PUG REST lookup, and dynamic compound/assay/substance context resolution with compound structures, property tables, descriptions, synonyms, assay summaries, depositor metadata, browser/API links, and recommended cross-database calls

ChEBI compound search, compound lookup, ontology parent/child traversal, and dynamic compound/ontology context resolution with chemical structure previews, synonyms, citations, xref groups, relation networks, ChEBI browser/API links, and recommended follow-up calls

QuickGO Gene Ontology term lookup, term search, child term traversal, annotation evidence search, and dynamic GO/evidence/TaxID context resolution with ontology-term cards, relation network previews, annotation tables, evidence links, recommended calls, and browser/API links

PRIDE Archive proteomics project lookup, project search, and metadata-only file manifest tools with project cards, reference previews, instrument/organism tables, download manifests, and browser/API links

BioStudies and ArrayExpress study lookup, search, and metadata-only file manifest tools with project cards, protocol/reference previews, external repository links, file manifests, and browser/API links

CELLxGENE Discover collection lookup, metadata search, and metadata-only H5AD asset manifest tools with single-cell project cards, ontology tables, citation/link previews, explorer URLs, and browser/API links

Human Protein Atlas gene lookup and search tools with expression summaries, subcellular localization, antibody evidence, cancer prognostic tables, UniProt/Ensembl cross-references, and browser/API links
MetaboLights study lookup, EBI Search discovery, and metadata-only file manifest tools with metabolomics project cards, assay/protocol/publication tables, download manifests, and browser/API links

HMDB metabolite, protein, disease, and pathway search tools with compound/protein/dataset/pathway records, chemical structure and sequence previews, xref groups, HMDB browser links, and explicit Cloudflare challenge reporting
MGnify microbiome and metagenomics study search, study lookup, sample lookup, and biome lookup tools with project, sample, taxonomy, metadata-table, and relationship-link previews

ENCODE functional genomics experiment search, experiment lookup, biosample search/lookup, file lookup, and metadata-only file manifest tools with project cards, sample cards, assay/biosample summaries, GEO links, download manifests, and browser/API links

cBioPortal cancer genomics study search, study lookup, dynamic profile/sample-list context resolution, molecular profile listing, sample-list listing, mutation table fetch, numeric molecular data matrix, discrete copy-number matrix, clinical attribute listing, clinical data matrix, and survival row tools with project cards, dataset tables, heatmap previews, gene mutation rows, cohort clinical rows, compatibility diagnostics, recommended fetch calls, PubMed/cBioPortal links, and browser/API links

KEGG REST info, list, find, get, conv, link, ddi, dynamic database/organism/pathway/coloring context resolution, and pathway coloring tools with pathway/gene/compound/database/linkset/identifier-conversion records, KEGG entry URLs, colored show_pathway URLs, REST URLs, table/xref/text/sequence/chemical/download/network previews, parameter-domain discovery, rate-limit metadata, and license-use notices

Local omics visualization MCP tools that profile CSV/TSV result tables, score visualization template contracts, return explainable template recommendations, report contract coverage across the visualization catalog, and expose app-renderable route records
Metadata-only GEO/SRA download plans, omics sample sheets, and local tool runtime status checks
App-renderable bioinformatics record schema, preview contract, and TypeScript types
